extracted.name: Cherry Poke Cake
extracted.description: This Jell-O poke cake is topped with cherry pie filling and whipped topping for a fun, festive dessert that everyone will love.
ingredient_lines: 1 (3 ounce) package fruit flavored Jell-O® mix
1 (16 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
instruction_lines: Prepare and bake cake mix according to package directions for one 9x13-inch cake. Remove cake from oven. Poke holes at once down through cake with a fork. Holes should be at 1-inch intervals.
While the cake cools, combine gelatin with boiling water. Pour gelatin mixture over the cake. Top with cherry pie filling, then cover with whipped topping. Refrigerate cake for 1 hour before serving.
